name: Product Library Hero
description: A centered hero (pill, bold heading, sub, primary button) over a three-row band of app tiles that fades at both edges, with a glowing brand tile at the center, above a muted trusted-by row of placeholder wordmarks.
interactions: on first view (IntersectionObserver adds .is-inview) the tiles pop in staggered outward from the center (wpmn-plh-pop 500ms)
the center brand tile pulses a brand-tinted glow (wpmn-plh-glow 3s ease-in-out, starting 1s in)
the tile band is faded at both edges with an alpha mask; the primary button shifts on hover
prefers-reduced-motion: tiles rendered in place, no pop or glow
